content.title: Coachella YouTube set times revealed: Everything to know for Couchella
content.text: April 10, 2026, 12:01 a.m. ETCoachella is here, which means for everyone who can't make it out to the Southern California desert this weekend, Couchella is just a livestream away.The festival will stream for free on YouTube at youtube.com/coachella. It will unfold on seven different channels, each focusing on a different stage, with three channels — Coachella Stage, Outdoor Theatre and Sahara — streaming in 4K.Festival producers have unveiled the set times for this weekend's streams, which include weekend headliners Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber and Karol G.The livestream kicks off at 7 p.m. eastern time on Friday.
